mapper.insert: SELECT notification_seq.nextVal FROM dual INSERT INTO notification (notification_num, member_num, category, title, message, target_url, is_checked, created_at) VALUES (#{notification_num}, #{member_num}, #{category}, #{title}, #{message}, #{target_url}, 0, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT notification_num, member_num, category, title, message, target_url, is_checked, created_at FROM notification WHERE member_num = #{member_num} AND notification_num = #{notification_num}
SELECT notification_num, member_num, category, title, message, target_url, is_checked, created_at FROM notification WHERE member_num = #{member_num} ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_num DESC

SELECT notification_num, member_num, category, title, message, target_url, is_checked, created_at FROM notification WHERE member_num = #{member_num} AND (is_checked = 0 OR category = 'JOIN') ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_num DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_checked = 1 WHERE member_num = #{member_num} AND is_checked = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notification WHERE member_num = #{member_num} AND notification_num = #{notification_num}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE category = 'JOIN' AND target_url = #{target_url}
SELECT notification_num, member_num, category, title, message, target_url, is_checked, created_at FROM notification WHERE member_num = #{member_num} AND notification_num = #{notification_num}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET category = #{category}, is_checked = 1 WHERE member_num = #{member_num} AND notification_num = #{notification_num} AND category = 'JOIN'
